question: What is the primary goal of an expository essay?

options.A: To review a fictional book about healthcare
options.B: To tell a personal story about clinical work
options.C: To convince the reader to change their beliefs
options.D: To explain a topic using facts and evidence

explanation: Expository writing is strictly built around explaining and clarifying concepts using factual information rather than emotion. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h1)

question: Why must a student nurse avoid personal opinions when writing an expository essay?

options.A: Because instructors prefer reading long clinical case studies instead
options.B: Because personal opinions are always banned in all academic papers
options.C: Because patients never share personal views during antenatal care
options.D: Because expository writing requires strict focus on objective facts

explanation: The core purpose of this essay type is to inform and clarify without letting personal bias cloud the information. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h1)

question: Which of the following is NOT a core characteristic of an expository essay?

options.A: Organizing the content in a logical sequence
options.B: Maintaining an objective and professional tone
options.C: Using emotional language to persuade the reader
options.D: Relying heavily on verifiable factual evidence

explanation: Persuading with emotion belongs in argumentative essays, whereas expository essays rely on calm, factual information. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h2)

question: A student wants to write an expository piece about postpartum hemorrhage. Which sentence fits best?

options.A: I believe postpartum hemorrhage is the most terrifying emergency a midwife can face.
options.B: Every single midwife out there must agree that blood loss management is awful.
options.C: You should always feel panicked when a mother starts bleeding heavily after birth.
options.D: Postpartum hemorrhage is defined as blood loss exceeding 500ml after vaginal delivery.

explanation: The correct option states a clear, factual definition without emotional bias or personal opinion. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h2)

question: Which type of expository essay explains step-by-step how to perform a clinical procedure?
explanation: A process essay breaks down a procedure into clear chronological steps so the reader can understand how it is done. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h3)

question: What is the main focus of a comparison and contrast essay in midwifery?

options.A: Proving that one traditional remedy is better than all modern drugs
options.B: Listing every known disease without looking at treatments
options.C: Telling a personal story about a difficult night shift on the ward
options.D: Examining similarities and differences between two clinical methods

explanation: This specific format evaluates two subjects side-by-side to highlight where they align and where they differ. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h3)

question: Where does the thesis statement typically appear in an expository essay?

options.A: In the very middle of the conclusion paragraph
options.B: On a separate reference page at the very back
options.C: As the opening sentence of the final body paragraph
options.D: At the end of the introduction paragraph

explanation: Placing the thesis at the end of the introduction gives the reader a clear roadmap of what the essay will explain. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h4)

question: What is the proper function of a conclusion in an expository essay?

options.A: To apologize to the reader for any difficult medical terms used
options.B: To argue forcefully against the facts presented in the body paragraphs
options.C: To introduce brand new research studies that were forgotten earlier
options.D: To summarize main points and restate the thesis without adding new facts

explanation: A conclusion wraps up the paper neatly by reinforcing the core message without bringing in fresh, untested arguments. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h4)

question: Why is a narrow clinical topic better than a very broad one for a short essay?

options.A: It allows the writer to explain the subject thoroughly and deeply
options.B: It prevents instructors from reading what the student wrote
options.C: It ensures the essay has no paragraphs or introduction
options.D: It guarantees that the student will use zero reference books

explanation: Narrow topics give enough room for detailed, specific explanation without skimming the surface of massive subjects. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h5)

question: Which of the following is a well-formed thesis statement for an expository nursing essay?

options.A: Let me tell you why I really love working in the maternity labor ward.
options.B: Is it true that all pregnant women experience severe morning sickness?
options.C: Partographs improve labor outcomes by providing early warning signs of fetal distress.
options.D: Midwives should never use any technology when delivering babies.

explanation: This option clearly states a factual, focused point that can be explained using evidence in the body paragraphs. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h5)

question: Which source is considered most credible for evidence in a Nigerian midwifery essay?

options.A: Personal diary entries written during secondary school
options.B: Unverified rumors shared in local market gossip
options.C: Anonymous posts found on social media entertainment pages
options.D: Federal Ministry of Health guidelines and WHO reports

explanation: Official health ministries and global organizations provide verified data and trusted clinical guidelines. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h6)

question: Why must a writer introduce and explain statistics rather than just placing them alone in a paragraph?

options.A: To confuse the instructor grading the written assignment
options.B: To help the reader understand the clinical meaning behind the numbers
options.C: To hide the fact that the numbers were guessed
options.D: To make the essay look longer than it actually is

explanation: Raw numbers without context do not explain themselves well; the writer must connect the data to real clinical practice. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h6)

question: What is a major pitfall where an expository writer starts arguing for a viewpoint instead of explaining facts?
explanation: An expository essay must remain neutral and informative, avoiding the trap of arguing for a personal belief. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h7)

question: Why is making a sweeping statement like 'all pregnant women refuse care' dangerous in an essay?

options.A: It proves that the writer read too many scientific textbooks
options.B: It is too short to fit nicely into a standard body paragraph
options.C: It is an unsupported generalization that lacks factual demographic backing
options.D: It uses too many complicated medical terms for beginners

explanation: Broad claims without proof weaken the objective, evidence-based nature of expository writing. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T4#BMP115_U4_T4_h7)
